fusions.name: Gutter Gnaw
fusions.desc: A dirty bite that deals 8 damage and 1 damage a second for 5 seconds, leaving the target [Diseased] for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Cornered Frenzy
fusions.desc: Lashes out at every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage as a critical hit. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Scuttle Clear
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Out Through the Drain
fusions.desc: Once every 240 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
